entries.name: Wikinews · German and English
entries.use: New AI-labelled news pilot: 360 native DE/EN title+lead inputs collected; 342 labelled, 244 Train /49 Val /49 Test.

entries.status: Open-text AI-labelled pilot; single-assistant reference labels.
entries.scope: Attribution licences permit commercial sharing/adaptation of covered text. Per-page source/revision/history links, hashes and transformations are retained. German text CC BY2.5; English article-era policy CC BY2.5/4.0, with both terms preserved for later contributions to older articles. Images/quoted leads excluded. This is a small single-source short-news pilot; the same AI created and reviewed the labels, not a human annotation panel.
entries.attribution: Wikinews / de.wikinews.org and article contributors, with original page/history links.
entries.revision: Per-page revisions frozen in reports/common_data_v3/source_manifest.json; protocol commit cbf0d86.

entries.name: GerNTSA · German news topic sentiment
entries.use: Possible German labelled auxiliary source; not yet approved for training.
entries.status: Conditional: verify source-text rights and target-to-global label mapping.
entries.scope: Local inspection: 3,792 target-labelled rows, 3,632 distinct snippets; negative 573, neutral 2,255, positive 964. Publisher permissions were not independently established. Topic/target labels do not automatically equal article sentiment. Mixed targets must not be relabelled neutral; article grouping cannot be claimed from the supplied fields alone.
entries.attribution: GerNTSA contributors / cgoer; credit dataset URL and indicate filtering.

entries.name: SENTiVENT · English financial events
entries.use: Potential annotation/guideline reference; not a cleared replacement text corpus.
entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 annotations/content; Apache-2.0 software; source news explicitly excluded
entries.status: Conditional: obtain article permissions before including source text.
entries.scope: The licence expressly excludes third-party news articles. Structured target/event annotations need an audited mapping to our three global classes. Do not label every unannotated sentence neutral. Useful for investor-relevant factual sentiment and a later span task, not a drop-in publishable bilingual corpus.
entries.attribution: Gilles Jacobs; annotations and original guidelines: Gilles Jacobs and Ghent University. Dataset DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/8JEC2.
